verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a database product with a cloud dashboard, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows ways for external agents to reach HelixDB: a hosted MCP endpoint, plus `helix chef` installing query skills and a docs MCP for the user's own agent. None of this is an assistant built into the product that a user can delegate tasks to, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
